context_and_flow.screen_type: App onboarding welcome screen for a fitness/running application.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: Welcome the new user, encourage newsletter sign-up, and prompt user to start onboarding or enter a referral code.
ux_patterns: The hero image is a realistic photograph of people running/exercising.
The layout uses a dark overlay on the background photo to improve text readability.
Primary button uses a vibrant teal color, contrasting with the dark background.
The UI follows a standard vertical stack pattern for mobile onboarding.

interaction_elements: Primary button uses a vibrant teal color, contrasting with the dark background.
visual_keywords: Modern mobile application UI, dark mode, high-contrast, photo-heavy.
